root_cause_assessment.established_cause: The mark recorder was a standalone report-only process and its health was absent from the continuously published improvement digest, so termination could remain invisible.
root_cause_assessment.unknown: The exact reason the earlier recorder process terminated is not recoverable because no retained supervisor event or termination log exists.
root_cause_assessment.live_capital_impact: none established; the venue stop and live backend remained healthy
root_cause_assessment.research_impact: The current SPCX lifecycle contains a 110.796-second historical WebSocket mark gap and therefore remains technically censored under the five-second path contract.

implemented_detection.tamper_behavior: wrong symbol, source, authority, signing, order, cadence, progress, or timestamp contract raises and prevents success-shaped publication
implemented_detection.reason_no_automatic_restart: A duplicate sampler or repeated restart loop could worsen rate limits; detection is proven while self-healing remains a separate design decision.

validation.initial_red_test: failed with AttributeError because no mark-capture health surface existed
validation.real_one_cycle_publication: passed with exact status SHA, age, polls, and rows
validation.file_limit_check: all scoped files at or below 500 lines

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The merged REST and WebSocket path will resolve future index lifecycle mark risk at a maximum five-second gap.
hypothesis_ledger.next_evidence_trigger: first fully resolved eligible SP500 or SPCX lifecycle after recorder recovery
falsifiers: digest status becomes missing, stale, or stopped
source identity or no-order contract fails
venue mark crosses the protected trigger without the expected close

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep v51 execution unchanged and retain the new fail-explicit recorder-health surface while collecting the first complete post-recovery index lifecycle.
recommendation.Why now: The prior recorder disappeared silently during an open SPCX lifecycle near its stop.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Recorder source and status, current v51 checkpoint, WebSocket mark archive, prior capture journals, test suite, and real improvement-digest publication.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Research-path loss was silent even though live venue protection remained intact.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Every SP500/SPCX v3 lifecycle because venue stops use mark rather than trade-candle price.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Ignore the gap, infer from candles, auto-restart blindly, or publish explicit health; explicit health is the smallest validated response.
recommendation.Expected upside: Evidence degradation becomes visible within the improvement loop before it contaminates strategy conclusions.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Detection does not itself restart a stopped recorder, and the current lifecycle remains historically censored.
recommendation.Validation completed: Healthy, missing, stale, stopped, tampered-contract, real publication, and regression behavior.
recommendation.Validation still required: One complete post-recovery eligible lifecycle with merged mark gaps at or below five seconds.
recommendation.Success metrics: Continuous healthy status and exact stop/exit reconciliation across a resolved lifecycle.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: False healthy publication, material monitor instability, or any unexpected interaction with live execution.
recommendation.Confidence level: High on detection and isolation; medium on continuous recorder durability; low on index-route profitability until more both-side lifecycles resolve.

limitations: The exact prior process-termination cause is unknown.
The monitor detects but does not automatically restart the recorder.
No live strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, stop, exit, execution behavior, or deployment configuration changed.
